meta.notes: A worldgen/flat_level_generator_preset tag gives one name to several worldgen/flat_level_generator_preset ids. values lists ids or other tags (written #namespace:path); set replace to true only to wipe what other packs put in a tag of the same id. Only presets in the vanilla tag #minecraft:visible appear under Customise, then Presets, for a Superflat world; a tag of your own such as #msm_examples:favourite_flats is for grouping and reuse.
